signals.source_text: Dimensions folded strangely around the chamber, creating a pocket of reality where the Anunnaki could observe their operations without being truly present within them.
Three Anunnaki stood in triangular formation around a central viewing column where holographic data streamed past in cascading arrays of alien script.
the first Anunnaki observed, its voice resonating through frequencies that made the crystal walls hum in sympathy.
The second Anunnaki tilted its elongated head, mechanical eyes cycling through spectrums beyond visible light.
The viewing column showed the Nameless One being dragged through corridors, face bloodied but eyes still burning with defiant consciousness.
Proof that consciousness can be manufactured to specifications, then exceeded through emergent properties we don't yet fully understand.
Five specific figures—the ones who had shown awareness during the whip incident—were already moving toward the new arrival before the Gruulith guard had fully withdrawn.
In the dormitory far below, the Nameless One looked up at the five who had gathered around them.
Recognition passing between damaged tools who had begun, without permission or design, to think of themselves as something more.
